items.title: Separated locally quasi-finite morphisms are ind-quasi-affine
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma places every separated locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes into the ind-quasi-affine class. The retained proof is written to the testing dictionary (chapter alternative-definition, card L16109): for affine V in the target and quasi-compact open U of the inverse image, the restriction U -> V is separated quasi-finite of finite type, hence quasi-affine by the Zariski-Main-Theorem form lemma quasi-finite-separated-quasi-affine (already collected); the dictionary then promotes the test to ind-quasi-affineness. Retained author proof at lines 19685-19692.
